convention: row vectors, v_out = v_glb @ M. canonical: v_world = v_glb @ matrix. camera-referenced methods: v_axes = v_glb @ diag(1, 1, depth_sign), then view_aligned: v_world = v_axes @ R_view (full ground-truth camera rotation) or azimuth_aligned: v_world = v_axes @ R_az (rows = camera right, world up, right x up: gravity-up frame turned to the camera azimuth only). Then own-bbox normalisation in ground-truth world axes (max extent 1, bbox-centred) for every method. Fixed once per method, never per sample; no yaw search, no ICP, no ground-truth-derived scaling. depth_sign +1: the GLB's +z points toward the camera.

sources.trellis2: the official exporter writes (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y); inverse v_world = v_glb @ [[1,0,0],[0,0,1],[0,-1,0]]
sources.camera_referenced: the GLB carries no node transform and its x-y projection matches the input view; family and depth sign chosen once per method on 15 validation objects (lowest mean Chamfer and angular error)
